title: SOS
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A one-volume shoujo collection by Hinako Ashihara. In the title story, three high-school students run a secret dating agency until a client's date goes dangerously wrong and a teacher finds out; other stories follow a 1920s bookstore clerk and a rich young man who dreams of composing, and a high-school girl deciding whether to keep putting up with a thoughtless boyfriend.
life_message: Knowing what you want, keeping your self-respect and following your dreams matters, even when class or circumstance stands in the way.

content.note: Publisher blurb says a client needs rescuing from a date 'gone dangerously wrong'; MU lists Attempted Rape (detail to verify).

Teen crushes, a dating agency and a 1920s romance; no sexual content noted beyond the threat above.
